subject: history
title: Art & Architecture of India
description: Major temples, caves, and monuments with their locations and features

content.overview: India has a rich heritage of art and architecture spanning thousands of years, from ancient cave temples to medieval monuments.
keyPoints: Ajanta Caves (Maharashtra): Buddhist caves, paintings, 2nd century BCE - 6th century CE
Ellora Caves (Maharashtra): Buddhist, Hindu, Jain caves, Kailasa Temple, 6th-10th century CE
Elephanta Caves (Maharashtra): Hindu caves, Trimurti sculpture, 5th-6th century CE
Khajuraho Temples (MP): Chandela dynasty, Nagara style, erotic sculptures, 950-1050 CE
Konark Sun Temple (Odisha): Kalinga architecture, chariot shape, 13th century CE
Brihadeeswara Temple (TN): Chola architecture, Dravida style, 11th century CE
Dilwara Temples (Rajasthan): Jain temples, marble architecture, 11th-13th century CE
Sanchi Stupa (MP): Buddhist stupa, Ashokan era, 3rd century BCE
Mahabalipuram (TN): Pallava architecture, Shore Temple, 7th-8th century CE
Taj Mahal (Agra): Mughal architecture, Shah Jahan, 1653 CE
Buland Darwaza (Fatehpur Sikri): Mughal architecture, Akbar, 1575 CE
Red Fort (Delhi): Mughal architecture, Shah Jahan, 1648 CE

mnemonics.trick: H-T-B-R-G-C = Humayun's Tomb, Taj Mahal, Buland Darwaza, Red Fort, Gol Gumbaz, Charminar
mnemonics.explanation: Mughal monuments: Humayun's Tomb, Taj Mahal, Buland Darwaza, Red Fort, Gol Gumbaz, Charminar
Three temple styles: Nagara (North India), Dravida (South India), Vesara (Mixed/Deccan)

quiz.question: Taj Mahal was built by:
quiz.explanation: Taj Mahal was built by Shah Jahan in memory of Mumtaz Mahal

quiz.question: Which temple is known for Kalinga architecture?
quiz.explanation: Konark Sun Temple is known for Kalinga architecture

quiz.question: Ajanta Caves are famous for:
quiz.explanation: Ajanta Caves are famous for Buddhist paintings
